turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My wife, do not fret. Our son will marry well and care for the fool as you have. The gods will see to it that all is well.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know it is hard to let go, but you must look after them as I cannot. Ensure they are cared for and that the fool is well taken care of.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear, you must rest now. The eldest son will marry soon, and I will see to it that all your wishes are fulfilled. Do not worry, for I am here and will take care of everything.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I trust you, my husband, and I know you will do right by them. But promise me you will see to the fool's needs as I have.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please rest assured. I will take care of everything as Father says. I will marry soon and look after the fool as you have.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My son, your words are a comfort. I will see to it that the wedding preparations are made and that your mother's last wishes are honored.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please try to rest. Father and I will make sure everything is taken care of.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Thank you, my son. And Father, I know you will see to it. I only ask that you do not forget the fool's happiness above all.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, my heart is at peace knowing that our son understands his duty. I will ensure that every wish you have for the fool is fulfilled, and I will watch over him as you have.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Master Wang Lung, may I assist in any preparations for the eldest son's wedding? I will ensure everything is done with care and respect.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Thank you, my daughter-in-law. Your help will ease the burden and ensure that this time is peaceful for O-lan.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I thank you, my daughter-in-law. May your kindness bring blessings to our home. And Father, my son, rest assured I will watch over you all from the heavens, guiding you with every step.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will do my best to honor O-lan's wishes and to care for my family with all my heart.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, my heart is heavy but at ease knowing our son will marry soon. Let us ensure this day is filled with joy and not sorrow.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please rest easy. I will make sure that the wedding is a joyous occasion, as you wish.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son, your promise warms my heart. Let us hurry with the preparations so that I can see your happiness before I am gone.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will take care of the arrangements with all haste, my mother-in-law, and ensure the wedding is everything you desire.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Wang Lung, let us ensure that every detail is perfect for our son's wedding. I wish to see him happy before I leave this world.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you shall see our son's happiness. I will see to it that everything is prepared with the utmost care and joy.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will do everything in my power to ensure that the wedding is a beautiful celebration. Please do not worry about anything.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]
